services.name: Public Home

authority.detail: Source and CI are known, but the hosting mutation and recovery owner have not been verified.

services.alerts: Hosting provider and public HTTP health
services.runner: Home repository CI is known; verify the current hosting mutation runner and owner before use
services.mutation: Fail closed until the Home hosting mutation and recovery owner are read back; never couple it to a Live Docker release.

services.name: Live and Ops

authority.detail: The webapp repository owns Live integration; release remains the promotion branch.

services.alerts: Harmonic Beacon operational alert channel and service health
services.runner: GitHub Actions self-hosted labels [self-hosted, mona], identity beacon-runner, restricted hb-deploy helper
services.mutation: Production changes only through the release workflow and restricted hb-deploy helper.

services.name: Beacon Account and Listener

authority.detail: Account and Listener remain owned by the independent early-birds lane.

services.alerts: Account/Listener readiness and paid-listener queue alerts
services.runner: Account/Listener early-birds workflow; do not infer the Live runner boundary
services.mutation: Use only the branch-qualified early-birds workflow and runbooks; never fold this lane into Live reconciliation.

services.name: Tapestry, playlist and LiveKit media

authority.detail: Media services are integrated through the Live webapp repository.

services.alerts: Container health, LiveKit target monitor and media-specific alerts
services.runner: Live release runner for integrated production images; service-local tooling for focused diagnostics
services.mutation: Build, restart and roll back only the affected media service unless a shared contract requires more.

services.name: First-party Analytics

authority.detail: Analytics source and operational runbook are owned in the webapp repository.

services.alerts: Analytics source freshness, data quality, storage, backup and restore monitors
services.runner: Analytics systemd/Compose path on Mona as defined by the analytics runbook
services.mutation: Keep analytics migrations, runtime, dashboard and backups independent from Live deployment.

services.name: Payments, membership Authority and PMP

authority.detail: The canonical PMP/Authority repository, deployed revision, database and mutation owner remain unresolved.

services.alerts: Payment provider, membership authority and durable commerce queue alerts
services.runner: Unresolved until the canonical PMP/Authority owner and workflow are read back
services.mutation: Resolve the canonical owner repository, deployed SHA, database and runbook before mutation; sandbox only for payment tests.
